newsitem.title: MEXICO: Accused "Narco granny" awaits verdict in Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Accused "Narco granny" awaits verdict in Mexico.

text.p: An 82-year-old woman who confessed to selling drugs to teenage students will face a judge's verdict on Tuesday in the northern Mexican city of Monterrey.

Sofia Elena Garcia Caudillo, dubbed the "Narco-Granny" by local media, was caught by police with 14 marijuana cigarettes in her posession and she confessed to having sold drugs for 11 years. She was arrested along with eight students aged between 13 and 17 years.
Garcia may be let free, however, due to a legal provision that prevents people over 60 from serving prison sentences. The judge is expected to rule on the case on Tuesday.
